types.<t>.features: feature -> quantity key; 'state' -> enum submodel of the type (types.<t>.states); state_ru is the state in Russian words for display; service types have no responsible role.
things[].passport: key -> [value, unit, source key, note?]; things[].parent / feeds / supplies: names without namespace; responsible.person: the person twin who answers for the node.

site.title: Site
site.description: Sulphide part of the Aktogay concentrator: plant totals, run control, money basis.

pit.title: Open pit
pit.description: Queue of ore blocks dug by the excavators. Haul roads: visibility_m, road_grip (friction index 0..1), haul_speed_pct and road_restrict (traffic restriction in force) show the winter road.

exc.title: Excavator
exc.description: Face shovel (Hitachi): on ore it digs the current block, on stripping it digs waste. oil_pct / oil_alert: hydraulic oil contamination sensor (-1 where no source confirms one; EX3600-6 has it).

batch.title: Ore batch
batch.description: One block on its way from the face to the SAG mill. Created and deleted by the simulator; passport: block, est_cu, est_axb, est_ascu (block model estimates). The state follows the last tonne of the batch; pit_t is still in the pit, tonnes_left is not yet fed (weigher accounting).

crusher.title: Primary gyratory crusher
crusher.description: In-pit crushing station; lube_kpa is the oil pressure seen by the trip protection. service = 1 while the planned mantle change stops it.

conveyor.title: Overland conveyor
conveyor.description: Belt from the crusher to the ore stockpile.

stockpile.title: Ore stockpile
stockpile.description: Conical stockpile with bottom reclaim (draw column and sides).

line.title: Processing line
line.description: Line totals; cum_* are shift counters, cum_*_total keep growing.

sag.title: SAG mill
sag.description: Semi-autogenous mill; power_kw is shaft power.

ball.title: Ball mill
ball.description: Ball mill in closed circuit with the cyclones; power_kw is shaft power.

cyclones.title: Hydrocyclone cluster
cyclones.description: Classification of the ball mill circuit; open_count does not see a clogged unit.

flot.title: Flotation section
flot.description: Section totals and the on-stream analyser; parent of the rougher and cleaner stages.

rougher.title: Rougher and scavenger flotation
rougher.description: First order kinetics stage; dose_meas_gt is the collector flowmeter reading. tank_t: collector day tank on load cells; tank_in_t_total: booked deliveries; dose_t_total: flowmeter totalizer (the tank balance against it shows an overdose).

cleaner.title: Cleaner flotation with regrind
cleaner.description: Cleaner stage with constant stage recovery.

water.title: Tailings and water
water.description: Water balance with the tailings pond; SHORT while the fresh water is at its supply cap and the ore is cut; piezo_kpa is the dam reading (the piezometers are piezo-N things).

power.title: Power supply
power.description: Grid limit and site load; grinding_mw from the grid, grinding_shaft_mw on the shaft.

crew.title: Repair crew
crew.description: Crew of one trade; free_at is the model minute when it is free.

fleet.title: Pit fleet
fleet.description: Pit fleet in numbers; the trucks themselves are truck-NN things (state machine on the aggregated haul).

pebble.title: Pebble crushing
pebble.description: Pebble crushing loop back to the SAG mill; LIMIT at 95 % of the limit. Line 2: limit = min(cones, HPGR 1 061 t/h); hpgr_* features show the HPGR load and drive power.

thick.title: Concentrate thickener
thick.description: Concentrate inventory between cleaners and filter.

filter.title: Concentrate filter
filter.description: Filter presses of the line; ONE while one press changes cloth.

conc-stock.title: Concentrate store and rail loading
conc-stock.description: Shared by both lines; trains take concentrate twice a day.

person.title: Person of the shift
person.description: One person on duty: crews book jobs through the person of their trade; decision roles go to the node they are called to. OFF while evacuated or off shift.

truck.title: Haul truck
truck.description: Truck cycle as a state machine on top of the aggregated haul; published every 30 model minutes.

face.title: Pit face
face.description: Face of one excavator: block being dug with its block-model grade and hardness; blasted_t is the blasted rock ready to dig (drill rigs add, the excavator takes).

road.title: Haul road
road.description: Haul road or ramp; CLOSED sends the trucks of its line on a detour.

drill.title: Blast-hole drill rig
drill.description: Drill rig of a face (bort number from the company list of 29.02.2024); its holes add blasted rock to the face.

dozer.title: Dozer
dozer.description: Dozer of the pit (bort number from the company list of 29.02.2024).

analyzer.title: On-stream analyser
analyzer.description: Feed, tails and concentrate grades of a line; SUSPECT when the reading is stale.

weigher.title: Belt weigher
weigher.description: Belt weigher of the overland conveyor with its totalizer.

flowmeter.title: Reagent flowmeter
flowmeter.description: Collector flowmeter of a line; DRIFT once a dose drift is confirmed, SUSPECT while the tails alarm is on and it reads the setpoint.

piezometer.title: Dam piezometer
piezometer.description: Pore pressure in the tailings dam; alarm (S0) at or above the safety setpoint.

mod-losses.title: Module: where copper is lost
mod-losses.description: Written by akt-losses every 5 model minutes; node keys sag-N, cyclones-N, flot-N. suspect_sensors: instruments whose reading the module doubts (thing names). Silent overspends: SAG kWh/t measured against Morrell on the batch estimate (sag-N_e_*, energy_usd_h), collector tank balance against the flowmeter (rougher-N_reagent_*), water balance residual as a leak (water_leak_m3h); silent_text sums them up.

mod-ore.title: Module: which ore is coming
mod-ore.description: Written by akt-ore every 15 model minutes; layers_l* are JSON strings.

mod-priority.title: Module: queue of issues
mod-priority.description: Written by akt-priority every 5 model minutes; auto_call = {seq, issue, role, sim_time}. Decisions in the queue: hard ore (blend), grid cut (what to shed first and its cost), shortage of return water, fire at the HPGR (S0). Shift handover sheet at 07:30 and 19:30 model time: handover {at, text, issues, snoozed, sensors, ore, crews}, handover_draft_text (what to hand over now); escalations {issue-N: {t, eta, text}}: a called person or crew not arrived by ETA + 15 min. Deviations (grinding media overuse) go to deviations/deviations_text, not to the queue; decisions = calls of the shift against the model's order, review_text = 'what if you had called otherwise' for the handover; tariff = hourly tariff band (assumption). Issue: chain (main -> deputy -> shift head), chain_text, choice_text. handover_btn = {show, from, end, lead_min}: the button 'Сдать смену' is shown lead_min minutes before the end of the shift, and only then. alarm_flood = {shift, elapsed_min, events, nodes, now, issues, main, per_10min, isa_per_10min, isa_per_shift, label}: entries of nodes into abnormal states in this shift against the issues of the queue and the one on the main screen (lower bound; ANSI/ISA-18.2 orientation about 150 alarms per operator per day), alarm_flood_text = the same in one line for the shift report.

issue.title: Issue
issue.description: Created by akt-priority as issue-<n>; safety_class S0, S1 or empty. loss_usd_h is the rate once losses run, loss_from the model minute they start (-1: none expected, or a safety issue that is not counted in money). status_ru: the status in Russian words; person: the person twin to call. eta: expected arrival of the called person or crew; escalation: 'not arrived by ETA + 15 min' text (empty when none). evidence = measurements behind the issue {items: [{label, thing, feature, text, unit, where, age_pub_min, age_meas_min, suspect, old}]}: age_pub_min is the age of the data on the screen, age_meas_min the age of the sample itself (analyser, grab sample); notify_text: roles told besides the one called (new face, regime to change). lifecycle = {stage, stage_ru, steps: [{key, ru, t, src}], help, help_text, text}: new, called, accepted, on the way, on site, resolved; accepted / on the way / on site come from the called person (journal.mech), else from the model, marked in src. lever = {name, line, value, unit, reason, label} (only for advice that changes the regime: the interface offers one click that sets this what-if lever in the model; empty otherwise). cost = {usd_h, items: [{key, title, usd_h, label, supports: [{what, label}]}], horizon, weakest, text}: the price split into copper, energy, reagents and penalty, and what each part stands on (fact, calculation, assumption).

control.title: Stand control
control.description: Written by akt-web only; each command is an object with a growing seq. lever = {seq, feed_1, feed_2 (% of the nominal line rate), p80_um (grind target), dose_gt (collector dose), reset}: what-if levers, control of the model and not of the plant.

journal.title: Call journal
journal.description: Written by akt-web only; last = {seq, issue, action, role, text, sim_time}; mech = {seq, issue, status, person, run, sim_time, items: {issue-N: {status, person, run, t, log: [{s, t}]}}}: the status that the called person pressed on the mechanic screen (accepted, enroute, onsite, help, done).

validation-sim.title: Simulator truth log
validation-sim.description: Written by akt-sim only after a hidden cause ends; read by the interface only.

validation-calib.title: Calibration and validation
validation-calib.description: Written by akt-calib only; report_json holds the tables.

baseline.title: Model copies
baseline.description: Written by akt-sim only: base, loud-first and no-twin copies; the simulator adds <thing>_<feature>_base features.

phmeter.title: pH meter
phmeter.description: Online pH sensor of the rougher; the control holds its reading at the setpoint, lab_ph is the last grab sample with a hand-held meter (check value), age_min its age. DRIFT once a drift is confirmed.

leach.title: Heap leach pad of the oxide ore
leach.description: Oxide line: heap leach -> SX-EW -> cathode. One state and the cathode level of the quarter from the production reports; the ore on the pad, irrigation and solution grades are not published.

sxew.description: Oxide line: cathode t/h as a quarterly figure of the production reports (not a measurement), integrated since the start of the run.
